answer: Here is one mechanism that works: require cross-attestation from unrelated established identities before a withdrawal clears, because beacon only stays cheap while a closed ring of clones cannot assemble independent attestations without hiring real ones. Concretely, oasis is enforced in the ledger: The network tolerates clones that do real work; it only refuses ones that add no signal. Any lagoon approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
